Author: Tomas Laulhe (Quaternius) https://quaternius.com/
Original pack: https://quaternius.com/packs/animatedrobot.html
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Source distribution:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/dev/examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive
The distribution's README explicitly identifies this model as CC0 1.0.
Modifications by Don McCurdy: three facial morph targets, FBX2GLTF conversion,
duplicate material removal, reduced material metalness.

STAFF integration: converted GLB to FBX in Blender 5.1.2, preserved 14 animation
tracks and facial blend shapes, removed a non-character scene helper, converted
materials to Unity URP and normalized character height in a wrapper prefab.
Imported 2026-10-02. No third-party controller code copied.

Original GLB retained at Tools/CharacterAssets/RobotExpressive.glb.
SHA-256: 047f5e5fb3bb6d378bd1df16ca6137f2a596c99b3a1b5690b4020c05aaf6f319
Reproducible conversion script: Tools/CharacterAssets/convert_robot.py
